Values time efficiency over CO2-trade-offs. Deeply frustrated by paying for rigid annual or monthly flat-rates (like premium rail tiers) when a project shift makes them obsolete. Dislikes the manual overhead of researching, tracking expiration dates, and constantly optimizing his contract portfolio across fragmented mobility providers
